shapeSummary: Split-ring clamp mount, 8 mm thick along Y (Y=0..8). Ø48 mm outer ring with a Ø36 mm through bore centered at X=0, Z=0. Flat base block with its mounting face 24 mm below the bore center. Right-side block extends to X=26 and is split by a 1.5 mm horizontal slit above the bore centerline to form the clamp.
warnings: Overall X width (~52 mm) and 8 mm thickness are estimated from image proportions.
Clamp screw and its hole are omitted because their size is not given.
Foot notches and relief cutouts on the underside are omitted, so the base is a simple block.
Slit position and width, and the right-side block shape, are approximated from the image.
No base mounting holes are modeled because none are dimensioned or clearly visible.
cadquery:
ring = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(24).extrude(-8)
base = cq.Workplane('XZ').center(1, -16).rect(50, 16).extrude(-8)
tab = cq.Workplane('XZ').center(13, -5).rect(26, 38).extrude(-8)
body = ring.union(base).union(tab)
slit = cq.Workplane('XZ').center(15, 9.75).rect(30, 1.5).extrude(-8)
body = body.cut(slit)
bore = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(18).extrude(-8)
part = body.cut(bore)
